entities.name: Fallaji Empire
entities.description: A great alliance of desert nomad tribes on Terisiare that formed the main body of Mishra's army.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: The continent of Dominaria where the Fallaji lived.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Brother of Urza who united the empire under the Suwwardi and ruled the Fallaji; described as having too much fire.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Described as having too much stone.

entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
entities.description: Allied with the Fallaji during the war.

entities.name: Suwwardi
entities.description: Militant Fallaji tribe that captured and later united the empire under Mishra.

entities.name: Tomakul
entities.description: De facto capital city of the empire and a Fallaji tribe.

entities.name: Zegon
entities.description: Southern coastal city, ruined after the war.

entities.name: Hajar
entities.description: Mishra's loyal bodyguard who led the Fallaji at the Fall of Terisia City.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war that united the tribes under the Suwwardi.

entities.name: Last Battle
entities.description: The battle in which nearly all Fallaji were killed.

entities.name: Tomakul Campaign
entities.description: Trench warfare in which the Fallaji nearly lost Tomakul.

events.summary: During the Brothers' War the tribes are united under the Suwwardi and later ruled by Mishra; Fallaji infantry fight at Kroog and Terisia City.
events.quote: During the Brothers' War the tribes were united at last under the Suwwardi tribe

events.summary: The Fallaji push the Argivians back from Tomakul.
events.quote: managed to push the Argivians back

events.summary: Nearly all Fallaji die in the Last Battle and the empire collapses; Tomakul and Zegon are ruined.
events.quote: Nearly all the Fallaji were killed in the Last Battle, and the empire collapsed after the war.

relations.quote: desert nomads on the continent of Terisiare

relations.note: Formed the main body of his army.
relations.quote: The Fallaji formed the main body of his army
managed to push the Argivians back
